name: io.github.samad001z/norn
title: Norn
description: Local-first, persistent memory for AI coding agents — remember, recall, forget, and list, over MCP.

environmentVariables.name: NORN_DETECT_CONFLICTS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to opt in to possible-conflict detection. Off by default; downloads a small NLI model on first use. Surface-only — never edits, merges, or deletes memories.
